description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.1.9
更新内容
- 新增 Snow Shot Mini：提供独立的精简版，保留截图、标注、贴图、录屏和手动文字识别；不包含翻译、二维码、表格、公式识别及图像转 Markdown/HTML 等功能。文字识别入口默认隐藏，可在设置中开启；Windows 首次识别时按需下载 OCR 资源。完整版与 Mini 的设置和更新相互独立。
- 录屏声音更好控制：麦克风和系统声音可分别调节增益，实时音量指示帮助检查声音大小、削波和音源状态。
- 录屏后期处理：支持先录制、再处理效果，显示处理进度，并可取消、重试或保留源文件；新增进度条与播放时间叠加效果。录屏工具栏可直接打开录屏设置。
- 长截图更方便查看：悬停缩略图可预览对应区域，改进颜色还原；优化 HDR 截图的颜色转换、性能及取色准确性。
- 贴图与文字操作：重新固定剪贴板截图时保留外观和位置；新增置顶、边框切换快捷键；双击识别出的文字块即可复制。修复贴图缩放滤镜和画布文字编辑问题。
- macOS 与稳定性：新增应用调度优先级设置；修复窗口截图阴影、放大镜动画和目标窗口选择问题。减少截图、录屏、历史记录和编辑窗口关闭后的资源占用，并改善 GIF 对比度与纹理填充显示。
下载选择：Windows x64 完整版提供联网安装、离线安装和便携版；Mini 提供联网安装和便携版。macOS 15+ Apple Silicon 两个版本均提供 DMG。*-update.zip 用于内置更新器；校验文件和签名更新元数据随包提供。
What's new
- Snow Shot Mini: a separate, streamlined edition for screenshots, annotations, pins, recording, and manual text recognition. Translation, QR, table and formula recognition, and image-to-Markdown/HTML conversion are omitted. Enable the initially hidden text-recognition action in settings; Windows downloads OCR resources on first use. Mini keeps its own settings and updates.
- Recording audio: adjust microphone and system-audio gain independently, with live meters showing levels, clipping, and source status.
- Recording post-processing: capture first and process effects afterward, with progress, cancellation, retry, and an option to retain the source. Add progress-bar and playback-time overlays, and open recording preferences directly from the toolbar.
- Scrolling and HDR capture: hover over scrolling-capture thumbnails to preview the corresponding region. Improve color restoration, HDR conversion performance, and color-picking accuracy.
- Pins and recognized text: preserve screenshot appearance and placement when pinning clipboard content again; configure always-on-top and border shortcuts; double-click a recognized text block to copy it. Fix scaled filters and canvas text editing.
- macOS and reliability: configure application scheduling priority; fix window-capture shadows, magnifier animations, and target-window selection. Release resources more promptly after capture, recording, history browsing, and editing; improve GIF contrast and patterned fills.
Downloads: Windows x64 offers online, offline, and portable packages for the full edition, and online/portable packages for Mini. Both editions offer DMGs for Apple Silicon on macOS 15+. *-update.zip files are for the built-in updater. Checksums and signed Windows update metadata accompany the packages.
